>
> So if I play it and it comes to a crosstable player... I can block him
> moving it to, say, my predator, without Eagle's Sight and such?

No, because he's not taking an action AGAINST the card, he's taking a (D)
action granted by the card to target a specific minion.

If there were an action you could take against the card (not the minion it
is on), I guess you might be able to block.

Of course, IANLSJ...

Unique Master. Put this card on a vampire. During his or her
controller's untap phase, the vampire with this card either burns 1
blood or is burned (the controller's choice). A vampire with this card
can put it on any other vampire as a +1 stealth (D) action.

D action. Forgot the most important part.

Well, there's some benefit in the fact that ousting the Methuselah who
played it whipes the Society from the table.
